title: The grouped values behind the asserted Acme Outfitters visuals (expected.json), as DAX

cases.query:
EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Products'[Category], "IsTotal"), "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Units Sold", [Units Sold], "Margin %", [Margin %]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"}),
    'Products'[Category] IN {"Camping", "Hiking"},
    'Products'[List Price] >= 50 && 'Products'[List Price] <= 400
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Products'[Product Name], "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Units Sold", [Units Sold], "Margin %", [Margin %]), [Total Sales], DESC),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"}),
    'Products'[Category] IN {"Camping", "Hiking"},
    'Products'[List Price] >= 50 && 'Products'[List Price] <= 400
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Stores'[Store Name], "IsTotal"), "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Target", [Target], "Target Attainment %", [Target Attainment %], "Target Stretch", [Target Stretch]),
    'Stores'[Channel] IN {"Retail", "Outlet"},
    'Stores'[Region] IN {"West"},
    'Date'[Date] >= DATE(2025, 1, 1) && 'Date'[Date] < DATE(2026, 1, 1)
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Web Sessions'[Device], "Sessions", [Sessions]),
    'Stores'[Channel] IN {"Online"},
    'Web Sessions'[Device] IN {"Mobile"},
    NOT ('Customers'[Loyalty Tier] IN {"Unassigned"})
)
